description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kithkin Spellduster
When Kithkin Spellduster dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kithkin Spellduster enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kithkin Spellduster
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
